dedupe_keys.name: electrical load profile from a tool manufacturer

description: This PIEG-Strom deposit contains measured electricity demand from a German tool manufacturer during 2018. Tjarko Tjaden at Hochschule Emden/Leer publishes the profile to support the project's work on electrical storage and building-energy simulation. The resource consists of loadprofile_tool-manufacturer_2018.csv, available from Zenodo free under CC BY 4.0. Its release dates from April 2021. The landing page identifies the sector, country and observation year, but the facility location, sampling interval, load units and completeness checks remain unknown without inspecting the file. A modeller can use the series to test industrial load-following or storage-sizing assumptions, with care about transferring one factory's demand to another. The published profile is an observed time series, not an executable model. It is a companion within the same research project as other load-profile deposits, with no existing catalogue relationship explicitly documented.
